name: TryPost
description: Social media scheduler built for AI agents and the teams behind them

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, uploaded images and videos, and this install's secret keys (state/secrets.env and the Passport keys). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: TryPost web app, API, MCP and live updates, published on host as 6190

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6190, or use your https address. Images, videos and social network sign-ins are linked from it. Keep the port at 6190.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Your email. It is the sign-in of the first account, made on the first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password of the first account, used only on the first start. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one, shown in the app log in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Change it later in TryPost's profile settings.
